create_config_hyv3: create an HYV3Config instance with custom model parameters like num_hidden_layers and num_experts
build_model_hyv3: build an HYV3ForCausalLM model from an HYV3Config for autoregressive language generation
test_moe_forward: test the HYV3MoE forward pass with hidden states and optional fp32 combine
review_topk_router: review the HYV3TopKRouter forward method that applies router_scaling_factor to top-k expert weights
summarize_decoder_layer: summarize the HYV3DecoderLayer that combines HYV3Attention and HYV3MoE or HYV3MLP
